title: Subarray Sum Equals K
statement: Given an array of integers nums and an integer k, return the number of contiguous subarrays whose elements sum to exactly k.

examples.explanation: Subarrays [1,1] starting at index 0 and starting at index 1.

hints: A subarray (j+1..i) sums to k exactly when prefix[i] - prefix[j] == k.
So for each running prefix sum s, count how many earlier prefixes equal s - k.
Store prefix frequencies in a Map seeded with {0: 1} for subarrays starting at index 0.

solutions.title: All Start-End Pairs
Prefix Sum Frequencies

editorial.approach: Prefix sums with hash map: let prefix_sum be the running sum of elements up to index i. Any contiguous subarray summing to k satisfies prefix_sum - previous_prefix_sum = k, which rearranges to previous_prefix_sum = prefix_sum - k. Maintain a hash map recording frequencies of each prefix sum seen so far, initialized with {0: 1}. For each element, accumulate prefix_sum, add map.get(prefix_sum - k, 0) to the total count, and increment map[prefix_sum].
editorial.why_optimal: Solves in O(n) time with O(n) space, eliminating quadratic O(n^2) subarray scanning.
editorial.pitfalls: Omitting {0: 1} base case in the frequency map, failing to count subarrays that sum to k starting directly from index 0. Looking up prefix_sum - k after incrementing map[prefix_sum] when k == 0, counting an empty interval.
